must_use.reason: `self` will be dropped if the result is not used

trusted_assumptions: vstd CString::into_bytes_with_nul contract preserves the CString view and appends NUL
Box::into_raw and Box::from_raw preserve a modeled allocation token
core::mem::transmute establishes the modeled source/destination relation
axiom_cstring_view_valid: every CString view has no interior NUL
axiom_boxed_slice_token_view: a Box<[u8]> token denotes its byte sequence
axiom_boxed_c_str_token_view: a Box<CStr> token denotes its CStr view
axiom_boxed_bytes_cast_to_c_str: the transparent DST pointer conversion preserves allocation and removes the trailing NUL from the CStr view
rationale: The private extraction is source-faithfully expressed through into_bytes_with_nul followed by its boxed-slice inverse. The unsupported DST cast is desugared to an equal-sized pointer transmute and justified by explicit representation axioms.
